This chain of interactions implies that Dienestrol could modulate Mcl-1 through the action of Diospongin B, potentially affecting cellular processes associated with myeloid leukemia. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as the relationships are inferred through target-based associations, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct involvement of Dienestrol in Mcl-1 regulation. The mechanism is plausible, but the exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain and requires additional investigation.
